Hi Liam — quick technical context from payments ops:
- card_declined is generic; our logs show the decline source was an issuer 3DS challenge rather than insufficient funds.
- Splitting into two smaller charges can reduce the likelihood of a 3DS challenge because some issuers apply lower thresholds per-transaction; not guaranteed but a reasonable mitigation.
- If you update the card we can also enable our proactive card sync token (PSP token exchange) so subsequent retries use the latest tokenized instrument — reduces false negatives.

We have a short checklist to avoid chargebacks: signed PO + delivery confirmation + invoice with VAT ID (if EU). If you can attach the PO and VAT ID, we will attach them to the retry record.

Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/billing/card-update — this page explains the hosted update flow and token exchange. I've added a tentative calendar event (retry_schedule.ics) for Jul 12 02:00 UTC.

I'll hold dunning for 48 hours once you confirm. If you want us to split the invoice I can ask Billing to create RWI-4827-A and RWI-4827-B for 50% each.

Best,
Monica Patel
